description.value: A privately-run RV park on the Trans-Canada in the Fraser Canyon, 18 km from Hope, set among tall evergreens with mountain views, showers, laundromat, and an adjacent general store with café and smoked salmon. Dry tent sites are available, though the park is oriented toward RVs and the highway setting is busy.

address.value: 28775 Trans Canada HWY, Hope, British Columbia V0X 1L3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground 18 km outside Hope on the Trans-Canada Highway with 30 campsites and 35 long-term RV sites. Showers and laundromat are explicitly listed on the front page and facilities page. The on-site Hope River General Store provides restaurant, deli, bakery, and groceries, confirming food nearby. A reservation request form is present on the website. A gazebo is listed among amenities, serving as a covered shelter. OSM tags align with the website (camp_site, fee=yes, website match). No hiker/biker-specific sites or cyclist discounts are mentioned.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address; website provides both (604-863-2407 / 604-863-0033 and 28775 Trans Canada HWY, Hope, BC V0X 1L3)
No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites; tent cyclists may need to book a standard campsite
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground on the Trans-Canada Highway with showers, laundry, on-site general store with food, and a historical setting—a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists traversing the Fraser Canyon.

wow_evidence: Showers and laundromat explicitly listed; Hope River General Store provides restaurant, deli, bakery, and groceries
